"''This is security, Mon. You're confusing criminality and politics here.|Mon Mothma to senator|}} A [[human]] '''senator''' worked for the [[Imperial Senate]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. They had dark skin and grey [[hair]]. In [[3 BBY]], they met with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] and her aide [[Erskin Semaj]] while Mothma who was trying to get the votes to challenge the [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine's]] extension of the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]]. Despite voting with Mothma on issues related to sector boundaries, civil liberties, personal freedom and respect for local tradition they refused to support the challenge to the P.O.R.D. Telling Mothma not to confuse criminality and politics with respect to the bill which they viewed as being about security. During the meeting they had a short grey-white beard and wore an elaborate brown and gold [[robe]]. ==Behind the scenes== The senator was portrayed by [[Madhav Sharma]] and appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} They were listed in the episode's credits as simply "Senator #2" ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი სენატორი ადამიანი }} [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
